emails.subject: the sticky note on the fridge
emails.preview_text: It stayed there for two years.
emails.body_text:
Her roommate left a sticky note on the fridge before moving out. It just said: ‘You make hard days easier. — M’

Two years later, it’s still there. Faded, curling at the edges. She says she reads it on the bad mornings.

Write the note. You never know which one sticks.

emails.subject: what the cashier said back
emails.preview_text: She’d been having the worst week.
emails.body_text:
He told the grocery cashier she had a kind face. She laughed — then quietly said it was the first nice thing anyone had said to her all week.

He thinks about that a lot now. How close she was to going the whole week without one kind word.

Don’t assume people are fine. Say the kind thing anyway.

emails.subject: a gentle one for mental health day 💚
emails.preview_text: It’s okay to not be okay today.
emails.body_text:

Healing isn’t linear and rest isn’t laziness. Be as kind to yourself as you’d be to your best friend.

And check on your strong friend today. The one who’s ‘fine’ is often the one who needs it most.
